scientific_integrity: The corrected theorem distinguishes total computable optional-neighbor presentations from ordinary partial-recursive neighbor maps. The latter admit a halting-set counterexample at grounding stage one. Deductive proofs cover both the corrected classification and its necessary limitation; no external attestation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The structural theorem assumes both in-degree and out-degree at most one.
The effective degree theorem assumes total computable optional-neighbor functions returning an explicit no-neighbor marker.
Ordinary partial computable neighbor functions with potentially undecidable domains do not suffice; an explicit stage-one halting counterexample is provided.
No claim is made for grounding ordinals above omega or for higher-degree frameworks.
An older path-based specialization may already contain part of the effective degree classification.
title: Grounded semantics of degree-one argumentation graphs: exact stages and corrected effective degree spectrum
